text:
claire-sales: Heads up — EmberAI POC is ready to sign but procurement is asking for non-standard payment terms. They want a split annual payment (small upfront), remainder on Net75, and a 10% commercial discount. Can we get deal-desk + finance signoff?

alex-ae: Quick clarifying Qs — is this a true 12mo commitment or just a POC-to-contract conversion? Need ARR numbers and whether discount applies to the whole term.

claire-sales: It's an intended 12mo contract after POC. List is $180,000/yr. Customer asked to pay $30k now, then the rest on Net75. POC will run on Hosted credits for month 0-3, then move to Dedicated for production.

maria-finance: @claire-sales @alex-ae Net75 is outside our standard policy. Finance prefers annual upfront or Net30/Net45. For exceptions we require AR review and either a PO + credit check or additional protections (escrow/letter of credit). Please share legal entity + EIN.

alex-ae: EmberAI Inc, EIN 12-3456789. They said procurement can only cut a check monthly and will ask for a delayed invoice date. If we propose 40/60 split with Net60 on second invoice would that be viable?

maria-finance: 40/60 with Net60 is more palatable. Discount >5% needs Deal Desk review. Any discount above 7.5% requires CRO approval.

claire-sales: Customer requesting 10% given they bring a reference case. They also asked to push first invoice +30 days from signature.

dealbot: /deal-desk create request: DD-2026-4727 — requester: claire-sales — tags: [net_terms, split_invoice, discount] — status: pending docs

ryan-deals: I'll own DD-2026-4727. What I need: 1) list price and proposed net pricing, 2) exact billing schedule, 3) PO and EIN, 4) quick credit check or trade refs, 5) security questionnaire status. If they can do 40/60 + PO upfront I'll approve up to 7.5% discount. Anything >7.5% needs CRO sign-off.

samir-se: Tech note for the SOW/PO: cap POC consumption to avoid runaway costs and to justify discount. Suggest adding a billing cap in SOW and an explicit throttling policy. Example snippet for SOW:

```
invoice_schedule:
  - invoice_1: amount: 72000  # 40% upfront
  - invoice_2: amount: 108000 # 60% due within 60 days
billing_cap:
  tokens_per_month: 200000
```

claire-sales: I'll add that snippet to the SOW and push for PO + EIN today. Also will ask them to accept Net60 for the second payment instead of Net75 to align with finance guidance.

jordan-legal: Legal needs to include: termination-for-nonpayment clause, SLA credits (if production), and a payment-default cure period. Also check export controls (customer country?). If we're giving a >5% discount, include a clause limiting usage during POC and a clear conversion trigger.

maria-finance: Once we have PO + EIN + credit check we can consider Net60. If credit check returns low score, we require the full annual upfront or a payment guarantee. Please upload docs to DD-2026-4727.

claire-sales: Uploaded PO draft and EIN to DD-2026-4727. Pushed customer to confirm 40/60 + Net60.

ryan-deals: Received. I'll review pricing impact and prepare a Deal Desk memo. If customer finalizes PO + accepts 40/60 + Net60 and we keep discount <=7.5% I can approve without CRO. Otherwise routing to CRO.

dealbot: DD-2026-4727 status: Documents uploaded by claire-sales — awaiting reviewer action.

ryan-deals: Reviewing now. Expect decision tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

claire-sales: Thanks all — will update after procurement confirms exact invoice dates.
